description:
I found the man I was in a car accident with! And now she is at his house where she disguised herself as a man and got a job as a maid posing as her twin brother.

"Your name?" "Chae Yoo-min..." "Age?" "Twenty-five..." "Height?" "167 centimeters...", that man rolled his eyes and barely spoke.

He tilted his head with suspicious eyes and spoke in a determined voice. "I like to work until the time is up, after that stay out of sight". The suspicious cohabitation with the violent owner began like this.

"Don't eat pieces of bread, eat rice", "You can have lunch with me tomorrow". Without however, Siwoo, who was warned not to trip while working, keeps interfering with her daily work... Will she be able to continue working without him finding out that she is a woman?
